cards.title: Insurance Programme
cards.brief: Fifteen years of records linked once, then answered two ways — dashboards for the monthly questions, an assistant with sources for the rest.

cards.title: Fleet Management
cards.brief: Look up a plate, request a change, approve it — the three things behind a parking change, in one place instead of an email, folders and a spreadsheet.

cards.title: Meeting Minutes
cards.brief: A Cantonese transcript in, minutes in the department's exact Word format out: two language-model passes and one script.

cards.title: Air Cargo Load Planner
cards.brief: Drag ULDs onto a 747-8F, watch the centre of gravity move, lock what you want to keep and let a MILP place the rest — solved in the browser.

cards.title: NeoChain WMS
cards.brief: A warehouse system for an auto-parts factory that ran on paper: a PDA app for line workers and a web admin for line managers, built after a visit to the floor.

cards.title: BuildingOS Digital Twin
cards.brief: Six specialist agents inside a building-management platform, each grounded in the tower's own documents, so a facility manager gets a sourced answer instead of waiting for an engineer.
